# Hand artwork

The custom cursor uses the Hand and Hand Back Fist icons from Font Awesome Free 6.7.2, by Fonticons, Inc. / @fontawesome.

- Original icons: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.x/svgs/solid
- Icons license: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Project license information: https://fontawesome.com/license/free

Sam’s Canvas scales the SVG paths, colors the hands white, adds an outline, and animates between their open and closed states. The original SVG files with their copyright notices are retained alongside this file.
